narrative.details: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
narrative.objectives: Take Wiley's Note to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
narrative.requestItemsText: What business do you have with me? I am a very busy man. . .
